integrity: Evidence consists of explicit finite combinatorial construction, exact integer unimodular reductions, separate Lefschetz calculations and modular rank-one top-cycle checks; not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: The claim is only the complete rational automorphism representation for four unordered points on K3,3. The integral homology ranks and product-cycle relations are published and not claimed new. No integral equivariant lattice, cup ring, or general n-particle extension is established. The 2019 geometric-cycle presentation could imply the representation with additional signed calculations; exhaustive priority is unknown.
title: The full \(S_3\wr C_2\) homology character of four unordered particles on \(K_{3,3}\)
